1. Cumulative Spectral Decay (CSD) Mechanics
Slicing the minimum-phase impulse response h[n] with a moving onset taper reveals how energy dissipates across time. High-Q passive resonances (e.g., Alnico P-bass or StingRay MM) ring out for 4–8 ms, whereas broad active voicings settle in < 1 ms.
2. Causal Minimum-Phase Settling & Positive Polarity
Synthesized via Allomorph's vectorized homomorphic Hilbert real-cepstrum engine. Impulse responses feature zero pre-echo, causal onset, and strictly positive initial polarity (+) to prevent comb cancellations when blended in parallel.
3. 3D Topographic Catalog Relief
Switching to 3D Voicing Landscape stacks target voicings across the depth axis, exposing harmonic notch geometry and spatial comb-filter shifts directly as a continuous physical acoustic terrain.
